content.short: Phi generates virtual lands that represent users' on-chain activities.
content.description: Phi is developing a metaverse land system where virtual plots are generated from universal web3 building blocks, including ENS domains and wallet activity. Within each plot, unique virtual objects reflect a user's on-chain activity and identity. Phi then aggregates these objects into a coherent virtual city, with every city offering a distinct portrait of its wallet holder—highlighting achievements, status, and involved communities. The result is a living, wallet-scoped landscape where on-chain history becomes the fabric of place.
content.meta: Phi builds a metaverse of lands created from ENS domains and wallet activity. Discover Phi and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
